- **Do loop authors need a full driver?** — no, strategy loops only implement `s"},{"id":"p45s6","text":"etup(agentCtx)`; a driver loop is only for changing turn control flow itself."},{"id":"p46s1","text":"Full answers: docs/faq.md."},{"id":"p47s1","text":"## Terminology"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"Names follow DeepSeek Harness's own vocabulary (the official package
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` n"},{"id":"p48s2","text":"ever uses "engine"; it speaks of the
"agent factory and driver service"):"},{"id":"p49s1","text":"| Our term | What it means | Common / official phrasing |"},{"id":"p50s1","text":"| **driver** | The core agent-loop implementation that owns the `createAgent`/`resume` contract and "},{"id":"p50s2","text":"drives turns (`HeadlessAgentLoop` is the vendored official driver). | Official DSH: *agent loop* / *"},{"id":"p50s3","text":"driver* ("agent factory and driver service"). Other harnesses often say *engine* (e.g. Codex engine)"},{"id":"p50s4","text":" — DSH does not use that word. |
| **loop** | The COMPLETE loop an agent runs, as registered in the "},{"id":"p50s5","text":"`LoopRegistry`: a **strategy loop** (reuses a driver + installs agent-scoped setup) or a **driver lo"},{"id":"p50s6","text":"op** (`kind: 'driver'`, a full custom driver). `loop` is the whole loop; `driver` is only its engine"},{"id":"p50s7","text":" part. | Community: *agent loop* / *loop*. Do not use "loop" for the engine layer. |
| **strategy lo"},{"id":"p50s8","text":"op** | A loop that reuses a driver and only installs per-agent setup (mount a preset, add hooks). Th"},{"id":"p50s9","text":"is is the common case. | Roughly: a preset/profile plus an adapter on top of one engine. |
| **drive"},{"id":"p50s10","text":"r loop** | A loop that IS a complete driver (`createAgent`/`resume`), for control flow that differs "},{"id":"p50s11","text":"from the default driver. | Roughly: a full engine implementation. |
| **preset** | DSH's per-session"},{"id":"p50s12","text":" composition (tools + prompt sections), selected via the native picker. | Official DSH: *preset*. No"},{"id":"p50s13","text":"te: in everyday conversation "preset" sometimes means the loop — we always mean the tool/prompt comp"},{"id":"p50s14","text":"osition. |
| **model route** | The provider/model (+ reasoningEffort) a session's requests use. | Co"},{"id":"p50s15","text":"mmunity: model config / model selection. |
| **AgentFactory** | The `createAgent`/`resume` contract "},{"id":"p50s16","text":"the factory registry delegates to (`ctx.agents.setFactory`). | Official DSH: *AgentFactory*. |
| **h"},{"id":"p50s17","text":"arness** | The whole agent runtime platform (DSH itself, or Codex, etc.). | Common term across the e"},{"id":"p50s18","text":"cosystem. |
| **binding** | The durable `{ loop, driver? }` selection the dock records on a session "},{"id":"p50s19","text":"at creation (`agent-preset/selected` `data.agentLoopDock`). | Recorded selection / route binding. |"},{"id":"p51s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
